newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey shares fall on politics, cash shortage.
newsitem.headline: Turkey shares fall on politics, cash shortage.

text.p: Turkishs stocks fell sharply on Friday on cash shortage, triggered by weekend demand and public sector salary payments, and political uneasiness ahead of next week's parliamentary votes on corruption charges, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 ended 44 points down at 1,555. Volume was lower at 28.4 trillion lira after Thursday's 34 trillion lira.
"Lira shortage triggered sales," said Tunc Salman from Korfez Investment.
He said some negative political and economic news were blamed as a reason for the decline. "The index will stay in a narrow band between 1,500-1,600 till the middle of the next week."
Money rates opened firmer on Friday due to high demand by state banks for public secyor salary payments and cash demand caused by liquidity requirement ahead of weekend.

Some brokers said political worries increased ahead of the next week's parliamentary debates on corruption allegations involving party leaders and a leftist censure motion against the Islamist-led goverment expected to take place on February 25.
"Today's index level is seen as a support. There will not be any problem unless it falls below that level," said Murat Emrali from Eczacibasi securities.
Brokers said the selective activity, sparked by expectations of positive year-end results, continued during the day. GUZ
